player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: فارماسیت صحیح نیست؛ لطفاً حدس تانو [<number>] وایییییین.

message.round_guesses: بازیکن ۰ تخمین زده {guess0}؛ بازیکن ۱ تخمین زده {guess1}. بنابراین هدف: {target}.
